description: Golden AI Stream adoption across whole, stage-aligned, and adversarial chunks.
source:
# Why stable streaming matters

AI output arrives in fragments, but the UI should preserve identity while meaning evolves. See [@Engine].

```rust
let mut engine = StreamEngine::new();
engine.append("hello")?;
```

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Tokens --> Engine
  Engine --> ContentIR[Content IR]
  ContentIR --> UI
```

[@engine]: https://docs.rs/mdstream "mdstream engine"
